material_description: CB850 | N-doped zeolite-beta-templated carbon: acetonitrile CVD at 850 °C in zeolite beta template ZTB, template removed with HF; TGA residue typically <3% at 800 °C
purification_method: washed several times with 10% HF to remove the zeolite framework; dried in oven at 120 °C
source_location: main.pdf p.5 (JACS 129, 1677), Fig 4 curve b (CB850), digitized marker
notes: archive: Fig4_b_CB850.json; branch inferred from marker glyph (up-triangle = adsorption, down-triangle = desorption; legend glyphs are not printed in the paper); T printed as -196 °C; degas: outgassed under heating at 200 °C overnight, end pressure printed as 10^-10 bar (=1e-5 Pa), duration not numeric; BET range: P/Po 0.02-0.25 (as printed); isotherm_point_count is a lower bound (dense low-pressure markers could not be resolved); C (reconciliation): pore_volume_method = other refers to the total pore volume (N2 uptake at P/Po ca. 0.99, single point); the micropore-volume method is not stated; average_pore_diameter_nm = 0.6 is the HK PSD maximum stated for the Fig 2B inset carbons (CA850, CB850h, CB850); isotherm_point_count = 60 counts all plotted markers including the dense low-pressure ones (A had 39, a lower bound); value = mean of A and B digitizations of the same marker (B row HYC-0083-M195, archive fig4_b_seg3.json)
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy: carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 from He sorption data (IGA, up to 20 bar, 323 K); adsorbed H2 density 0.04 g/cm3
